sources.entry: Alf.io - Ticket reservation system. (Demo, Source Code) GPL-3.0 Java

summary.one_liner: alf.io is a free, open source event attendance and ticket reservation system for event organizers, built in Java on Spring with PostgreSQL.
summary.what_it_does: alf.io is described as a free and open source event attendance management system aimed at event organizers who care about privacy, security and fair pricing. The README covers building and running it with Gradle (including a wrapper) and a local PostgreSQL database, and it lists Spring profiles such as dev, demo, disable-jobs and jdbc-session that change runtime behavior. It can be packaged as a Docker image via a Gradle distribution task and a Dockerfile, and a docker-compose setup is provided for development. The README also covers contributing, IDE setup with Lombok, and integration tests run with TestContainers. The README does not list event-specific features in detail beyond the general description.
use_cases: organize conferences or meetups with fair pricing
how_to_run: Install Java 25 (JDK) and PostgreSQL 10 or later
Start a local PostgreSQL database (README gives a docker run example with user postgres, database alfio)
Log in as admin using the password printed on the console
Alternatively: docker-compose up (development mode); build image with ./gradlew distribution then docker build -t alfio/alf.io ./build/dockerize
notable: Privacy, security and fair pricing focus stated in the project description
Spring profiles for dev mode, demo mode, disabling jobs, and database-persisted sessions
Row security policies rely on the database user not being a SUPERUSER
Integration tests run against real PostgreSQL via TestContainers, with Podman setup notes
caveats: The README warns the v2 branch may be unstable and untested; it recommends building from a released version
Running in production with Docker Compose is stated as not officially supported
Requires Java 25 JDK and PostgreSQL 10 or later
